name: Acquisition Analysis (Target Company Side)
description: Independent acquisition-offer analysis supporting the target company's board: standalone value, consideration quality, shareholder interests, alternatives, certainty, and negotiation.
provider_note: OpenAI Responses or an OpenAI-compatible synchronous CommonStack gateway; configured server-side. Live research and ATL registration are not yet verified.

fields.label: Target Company
fields.description: Include identifiers sufficient to distinguish the entity.

fields.label: Buyer Company
fields.description: Required for a named-buyer offer assessment; disclose if identity is confidential or unverified.

fields.label: Research Cut-off Date
fields.description: Latest date up to which information may be considered.

fields.label: Valuation Date
fields.description: If omitted, the runtime uses the research cut-off date. Disclose justified exceptions.

fields.label: Report Currency
fields.description: Preserve source currencies and disclose conversions.

fields.label: What is the deal background?
fields.description: Describe the approach, transaction history, current status, and decision to be supported.
fields.placeholder: Describe the approach, transaction history, current status, and decision to be supported.

fields.label: What are the offer terms?
fields.description: Provide consideration, value definition, payment mechanics, perimeter, conditions, and any amendments.
fields.placeholder: Provide consideration, value definition, payment mechanics, perimeter, conditions, and any amendments.

fields.label: What are shareholders' priorities?
fields.description: Identify evidenced priorities concerning value, liquidity, timing, control, risk, and retained upside. Distinguish differences among holders.
fields.placeholder: Identify evidenced priorities concerning value, liquidity, timing, control, risk, and retained upside. Distinguish differences among holders.

fields.label: What financials and forecasts are available?
fields.description: Identify statements, forecasts, assumptions, periods, and their sources. Distinguish management forecasts from analyst scenarios.
fields.placeholder: Identify statements, forecasts, assumptions, periods, and their sources. Distinguish management forecasts from analyst scenarios.

fields.label: Are there other offers or ongoing discussions?
fields.description: Identify actual offers or discussions and their status. Separate these from hypothetical alternatives.
fields.placeholder: Identify actual offers or discussions and their status. Separate these from hypothetical alternatives.

fields.label: Who are the key shareholders and decision-makers?
fields.description: Identify relevant holders, security classes, voting or approval rights, decision-makers, and known conflicts.
fields.placeholder: Identify relevant holders, security classes, voting or approval rights, decision-makers, and known conflicts.

fields.label: What approvals and deadlines apply?
fields.description: Identify known approvals, response dates, contractual deadlines, and timing constraints.
fields.placeholder: Identify known approvals, response dates, contractual deadlines, and timing constraints.

fields.label: What are the negotiation priorities?
fields.description: Identify price, payment, liquidity, certainty, protections, or other priorities and explicit limits.
fields.placeholder: Identify price, payment, liquidity, certainty, protections, or other priorities and explicit limits.

fields.label: What documents are available, and what's in scope?
fields.description: List available documents and locations, access restrictions, included work, and exclusions. Listing a document does not establish runtime access.
fields.placeholder: List available documents and locations, access restrictions, included work, and exclusions. Listing a document does not establish runtime access.
